{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA rows: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA rows:", len(qa_rows))
print("QA rows - customer_segment:", qa_rows['customer_segment'].unique())
print("QA rows - converted:", qa_rows['converted'].unique())

# Now, check the loyal customer group
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print("Total loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))
print("Loyal customers with converted=1:", loyal_df['converted'].sum())

# Check if any QA rows are in loyal group
print("QA rows in loyal group?", len(qa_rows[qa_rows['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']))"}
